abort.no_unit_id: The unit did not report its ID, so Home Assistant cannot tell it apart from other units.

error.cannot_connect: No WAFE unit answered at this address. Check the IP address and that no other Modbus client is connected to the unit, because it serves only one at a time.

data_description.host: The IP address or hostname of the unit on your network. Give it a fixed address in your router.
data_description.port: The Modbus TCP port of the unit. The default is 502.

user.description: Connect to a WAFE heat recovery unit over Modbus TCP. The unit must be connected to your network with an Ethernet cable.

wrong_unit.message: A different WAFE unit answers at the configured address. Remove the integration and add it again with the address of the unit you set up.
